caption:
Every Saturday, about half a million people run a free 5K. The first one had 13 runners. 🏃

Bushy Park, London, October 2, 2004. Paul Sinton-Hewitt was injured, out of work and couldn't run, so he set up a weekly time trial to keep seeing his running friends. Timing: a stopwatch, pen and paper, and metal washers stamped with finish numbers. In 2008 it became parkrun. This June, Bushy Park hosted the 1,000,000th parkrun. Today: 2,800+ events in 23 countries, still free.
